ContactFormSubmission.title: Contact Form Submission
ContactFormSubmission.description: A submission from the website contact form.

fullName.description: The full name of the person.

email.description: The email address of the person.

contactNumber.description: The contact number of the person.

submissionDate.description: The date and time of the submission.

AdminUser.title: Admin User
AdminUser.description: An administrator user for the website.

uid.description: The user's unique ID from Firebase Auth.

role.description: The role of the user, e.g., 'admin'.

createdAt.description: The date and time the user was created.

Banner.title: Banner
Banner.description: A banner image for the website hero section.

type.description: The type of banner, either 'web' or 'mobile'.

imageUrl.description: The Base64 encoded data URI of the banner image.

altText.description: Alternative text for the banner image.

createdAt.description: The date and time the banner was created.

/contactFormSubmissions/{submissionId}.description: Stores all submissions from the contact form.
